research_question: Does property-wise protection prevent promotions that an aggregate-only rule would accept?

method.mode: offline replay of retained official protection reports
method.aggregate_only_rule: promote when candidate reward and total passed-property count do not fall below the parent
method.property_wise_rule: also require every property passed by the parent to remain passed by the candidate

cases.interpretation: The aggregate score ties, but the candidate loses a property that the parent passed.

claim_boundary: This replay shows that property identity can change promotion decisions when aggregate reward and passed-property count tie. It does not establish that Quant Research State search outperforms a generic Evolver.
